comments.text: From audit prompt gist: 'Resource consumption — atom leaks (String.to_atom/1 on input).' String.to_atom/1 creates atoms that are never garbage collected. If called with unbounded user input, it can exhaust the atom table (default 1M atoms) and crash the BEAM. Flag String.to_atom/1 when called with tainted data. Suggest String.to_existing_atom/1. Severity: Medium. Note: partially overlaps catseye-ie4 but this is specifically about DoS, not deserialisation.

title: Elixir: detect atom table exhaustion via String.to_atom on user input
